usedFor: AutoQuote3D produces orders and quotes for a print shop; Telegram is a chat. A “New Quote” or “New Order” in AutoQuote3D can be answered in a Telegram chat with “Reply To Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Quote” in AutoQuote3D, then “Reply To Message” in Telegram
bestTemplate.why: It sends the quote details into a Telegram conversation as a reply, which suits a shop that quotes inside chat.

watchOut: “Reply To Message” replies to a specific message in a chat, so you need that chat and message ID available. Both AutoQuote3D triggers poll, so the reply lags a bit.
